meta.stack: ASP.NET Core Web API + SignalR + EF Core + SQL Server + Redis + Ollama

priorityMeaning.P0: MVP blocker - nothing usable without it

conventions.dependsOn: Task IDs inside this file that must be 'done' before this task starts
conventions.dependsOnClient: Task IDs in tasks.client.json needed for end-to-end verification only (not for coding this task)
conventions.mvp: true = included in PRD section 52 MVP definition

phases.name: Foundation & Infrastructure
phases.goal: Solution skeleton, cross-cutting concerns, local infra running

phases.name: Authentication & Users
phases.goal: JWT auth with refresh rotation and profile management

phases.name: Document Management
phases.goal: Document CRUD, listing, lifecycle and resource authorization

phases.name: Document State & Autosave
phases.goal: Yjs update persistence, snapshots and debounced batch writes

phases.name: Distributed State (Redis)
phases.goal: Backplane, distributed locks, temporary collaboration state

phases.name: Sharing, Invitations & Permissions
phases.goal: Members, invitations, share links, enforced role matrix

phases.name: Comments & Mentions
phases.goal: Threaded comments, resolve flow, mentions and notifications

phases.name: Versioning & Revision History
phases.goal: Versions, snapshots, history, restore and compare

phases.name: Document Locking
phases.goal: Soft and hard locks with expiry and live events

phases.name: AI Assistant
phases.goal: Ollama-backed writing operations exposed as authorized API

phases.name: AI RAG (Optional)
phases.goal: Chunking, embeddings, Qdrant retrieval, document Q&A

phases.name: Production Engineering
phases.goal: Collaboration test suite, load testing, scaling, hardening, Docker

milestones.name: Backend boots with auth
milestones.exitCriteria: Register/login/refresh/logout work against SQL Server; Swagger authorized calls succeed

milestones.name: Document API complete
milestones.exitCriteria: All /api/documents endpoints pass integration tests with resource authorization

milestones.name: Real-time editing works
milestones.exitCriteria: Two hub clients exchange Yjs updates and awareness; state persists and reloads

milestones.name: Collaboration hardened
milestones.exitCriteria: Permissions enforced on REST and hub; invitations and share links functional

milestones.name: MVP backend complete
milestones.exitCriteria: Comments, versioning, offline resync and AI Phase 1 endpoints delivered

milestones.name: Production ready
milestones.exitCriteria: 9 critical collaboration scenarios pass; load target met; Docker image published

tasks.title: Create solution and layered project structure
tasks.description: Create the .NET solution with Api, Application, Domain, Infrastructure and Tests projects and wire project references following the layering rule (Api -> Application -> Domain, Infrastructure -> Application/Domain).
acceptanceCriteria: Solution builds with zero warnings on a clean clone
Domain project has no outbound project references
Api exposes a temporary /ping endpoint returning 200

tasks.title: Configuration and strongly typed options
tasks.description: Set up appsettings per environment, user-secrets for local dev, and options classes for Jwt, ConnectionStrings, Redis, Ollama, Cors and Persistence settings with validation on start.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing or invalid required option fails fast at startup with a clear message
No secrets are committed to source control

tasks.title: Docker Compose for local infrastructure
tasks.description: Compose file with sqlserver, redis, ollama and qdrant services including named volumes, healthchecks and a pull/warm step for the chosen local model.
acceptanceCriteria: docker compose up brings all four services to healthy
SQL Server and Redis are reachable from the host on documented ports
Ollama responds to /api/tags with the pulled model present

tasks.title: EF Core DbContext and initial migration pipeline
tasks.description: Add AppDbContext in Infrastructure/Persistence, configure SQL Server provider, entity configuration assembly scanning, and a migration + database update workflow script.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet ef migrations add works from the repository root
Database is created and reachable by the API at startup
Design-time factory allows migrations without running the API

tasks.title: Global exception handling and standard response envelope
tasks.description: Implement exception-handling middleware mapping domain/validation/authorization exceptions to the standard { success, message, code } contract, plus a shared ApiResponse<T> wrapper and an error code catalogue.
acceptanceCriteria: Unhandled exceptions return 500 with a generic message and a correlation id, never a stack trace
Validation failures return 400 with field-level details and code VALIDATION_ERROR
Permission failures return 403 with code DOCUMENT_ACCESS_DENIED

tasks.title: Structured logging and correlation ids
tasks.description: Configure Serilog with console + rolling file sinks, request logging enrichment, correlation id per request and per hub connection, and a redaction policy for sensitive values.
acceptanceCriteria: Every log line carries CorrelationId, UserId (when authenticated) and DocumentId (when applicable)
Passwords, JWTs and invitation tokens never appear in any sink
Log level is configurable per namespace without a rebuild

tasks.title: CORS, rate limiting and security headers
tasks.description: Configure a named CORS policy for the React origin with credentials, ASP.NET Core rate limiting partitioned by user/IP with stricter buckets for auth and AI routes, and standard security headers.
acceptanceCriteria: SignalR negotiate succeeds from the configured frontend origin
Exceeding the auth bucket returns 429 with Retry-After
Unlisted origins are rejected

tasks.title: Health checks and readiness endpoints
tasks.description: Add /health/live and /health/ready with checks for SQL Server, Redis and Ollama so containers and load balancers can gate traffic.
acceptanceCriteria: Readiness reports Unhealthy when SQL Server or Redis is down
Liveness stays Healthy while dependencies are degraded

tasks.title: OpenAPI/Swagger with JWT support
tasks.description: Enable Swagger UI in development with bearer auth definition, XML comments and grouped endpoints so the frontend can generate typed clients.
acceptanceCriteria: Authorize button attaches the bearer token to try-it-out calls
swagger.json can be exported for client type generation

tasks.title: User and RefreshToken domain entities
tasks.description: Define User (Id, Email, DisplayName, PasswordHash, AvatarUrl, CreatedAt, IsActive) and RefreshToken (Id, UserId, TokenHash, ExpiresAt, RevokedAt, ReplacedByTokenId, CreatedByIp) plus EF configurations and a migration.
acceptanceCriteria: Email has a unique index and is stored case-insensitively
RefreshToken cascades on user delete
Migration applies cleanly to an empty database

tasks.title: Password hashing service
tasks.description: Implement IPasswordHasher using a memory-hard algorithm with per-user salt and configurable work factor, plus a needs-rehash check for future upgrades.
acceptanceCriteria: Two hashes of the same password differ
Verification is constant-time
Raising the work factor marks old hashes as needing rehash

tasks.title: JWT access token service
tasks.description: Generate signed access tokens carrying sub, email, display name and jti with a short configurable lifetime; register JwtBearer authentication with strict validation parameters.
acceptanceCriteria: Expired or tampered tokens are rejected with 401
Clock skew is set to zero so expiry tests are deterministic
Token lifetime is driven by configuration

tasks.title: Refresh token issue, rotation and revocation
tasks.description: Issue cryptographically random refresh tokens stored hashed, rotate on every use, revoke the previous token, and detect reuse of a revoked token by revoking the whole token family.
acceptanceCriteria: Raw refresh tokens are never persisted, only hashes
Reusing a rotated token revokes the entire chain and returns 401
Expired refresh tokens are rejected and cleaned up by a background sweep

tasks.title: POST /api/auth/register
tasks.description: Register a user with email uniqueness check, password policy enforcement, hashed storage and immediate token issuance.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate email returns 409 with code EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED
Successful registration returns access token, refresh token and user profile
Weak passwords are rejected with field-level messages

tasks.title: POST /api/auth/login
tasks.description: Authenticate by email and password, issue access + refresh tokens, and log the login event.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid credentials return a generic 401 that does not reveal whether the email exists
Inactive users cannot log in
Login is recorded in the log stream without credentials

tasks.title: POST /api/auth/refresh
tasks.description: Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair using the rotation service.
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoint is anonymous but requires a valid refresh token
Returns 401 with code REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID for revoked or expired tokens

tasks.title: POST /api/auth/logout
tasks.description: Revoke the presented refresh token (and optionally all sessions for the user) and drop related presence/session entries.
acceptanceCriteria: After logout the refresh token cannot be used
Logout is idempotent and returns 200 for an already-revoked token

tasks.title: Authorization policy foundation and current-user accessor
tasks.description: Add ICurrentUser abstraction resolved from claims, a base policy registry, and helper attributes so controllers and hubs share one identity model.
acceptanceCriteria: ICurrentUser resolves the same user id in controllers, hubs and background-invoked services
Anonymous access to a protected endpoint returns 401, not 500

tasks.title: User profile and change password endpoints
tasks.description: GET /api/users/me, PUT /api/users/me (display name, avatar) and POST /api/users/me/change-password with current-password verification and refresh-token revocation on change.
acceptanceCriteria: Changing the password revokes all other active refresh tokens
Wrong current password returns 400 with code CURRENT_PASSWORD_INVALID

tasks.title: Request validation with FluentValidation
tasks.description: Wire FluentValidation into the pipeline, add validators for auth DTOs, and map failures to the standard error envelope.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid payloads never reach controller bodies
Errors are returned as a field -> messages dictionary inside the standard envelope

tasks.title: Authentication unit and integration tests
tasks.description: xUnit tests for hashing, token generation and rotation, plus WebApplicationFactory integration tests covering the register/login/refresh/logout flows against a test database.
acceptanceCriteria: Full auth happy path and 6 failure paths are covered
Refresh-token reuse detection has a dedicated test
Test run needs no manual database setup

tasks.title: Document and DocumentMember entities
tasks.description: Define Document (Id, Title, OwnerId, Status, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt, CurrentVersion, DeletedAt) and DocumentMember (DocumentId, UserId, Role, AddedBy, AddedAt), plus DocumentRole and DocumentStatus enums.
acceptanceCriteria: DocumentMember has a composite unique key on (DocumentId, UserId)
Status supports Active, Archived and Deleted
Owner is represented both by Document.OwnerId and an Owner member row

tasks.title: Document persistence configuration and migration
tasks.description: EF configurations with indexes for owner lookups, updated-at sorting and title search, plus a global query filter for soft-deleted documents.
acceptanceCriteria: Soft-deleted documents are excluded from queries by default
Index exists on (OwnerId, UpdatedAt desc)
Migration applies and rolls back cleanly

tasks.title: Document application service
tasks.description: IDocumentService encapsulating create, get, update, archive, restore, soft delete and duplicate with owner-membership bootstrapping and UpdatedAt maintenance.
acceptanceCriteria: Creating a document also creates the Owner DocumentMember row in the same transaction
All mutations touch UpdatedAt
Service never returns entities directly, only DTOs

tasks.title: GET /api/documents with search, sort, filter and paging
tasks.description: List documents the caller owns or is a member of, with query params for search text, sort (updated/created/title), scope (all/mine/shared/recent/archived) and pagination.
acceptanceCriteria: Results include the caller's role per document and last-edited timestamp
Documents the caller has no membership in are never returned
Paging metadata (page, size, total) is returned

tasks.title: POST /api/documents
tasks.description: Create a document defaulting the title to 'Untitled Document', initialise CurrentVersion to 1 and emit the initial version record hook.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 201 with Location header and the created document DTO
Caller becomes Owner
Empty title falls back to the default

tasks.title: GET /api/documents/{id}
tasks.description: Fetch a single document with metadata, caller role, member count and current version; authorized through the document access policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Non-members receive 404 rather than 403 to avoid id enumeration
Archived documents are still readable by members

tasks.title: PUT /api/documents/{id} (rename / metadata update)
tasks.description: Update title and metadata for callers with Editor or Owner role, broadcasting the change to connected clients once the hub exists.
acceptanceCriteria: Viewer and Commenter receive 403 with code DOCUMENT_ACCESS_DENIED
Title length is validated

tasks.title: Archive, soft delete and restore endpoints
tasks.description: DELETE /api/documents/{id} (soft), POST /{id}/archive, POST /{id}/restore with Owner-only authorization and cascade behaviour for members and live sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the Owner can delete or archive
Deleted documents disappear from all listings but remain restorable
Restoring returns the document to Active status

tasks.title: POST /api/documents/{id}/duplicate
tasks.description: Copy document metadata and the latest content snapshot into a new document owned by the caller, without copying members, comments or history.
acceptanceCriteria: New document title is 'Copy of {title}'
Content of the duplicate matches the source at duplication time
Members and comments are not carried over

tasks.title: Document resource authorization handler
tasks.description: Implement resource-based authorization (CanView, CanComment, CanEdit, CanManage) resolving the caller's effective role from ownership, membership or an active share link, with a short-lived cache.
acceptanceCriteria: One code path serves both controllers and the hub
Role -> operation matrix from PRD section 27 is enforced exactly
Cache invalidates immediately when a membership row changes

tasks.title: Document CRUD and authorization tests
tasks.description: Integration tests across all document endpoints for each role, plus negative tests for non-members and deleted documents.
acceptanceCriteria: Every endpoint has a test per role (Owner, Editor, Commenter, Viewer, non-member)
Soft delete and restore round trip is covered

tasks.title: Document content storage model
tasks.description: Define DocumentSnapshot (Id, DocumentId, StateVector, YDocState varbinary, CreatedAt, UpdateSeq) and DocumentChange (Id, DocumentId, UserId, UpdateBlob, Seq, CreatedAt) with configurations and migration.
acceptanceCriteria: Binary columns use varbinary(max) with no length truncation
Seq is monotonic per document and indexed
Snapshot rows reference the seq they compact up to

tasks.title: Yjs state repository (load and append)
tasks.description: Repository that loads latest snapshot + subsequent updates for a document, appends new updates, and exposes a GET /api/documents/{id}/state endpoint returning the merged initial payload for a joining client.
acceptanceCriteria: A client joining an existing document reconstructs identical content
Load cost is bounded by snapshot + delta count, not total document history
Server treats update payloads as opaque binary and never parses CRDT internals

tasks.title: Debounced batch persistence BackgroundService
tasks.description: Buffer incoming Yjs updates in memory/Redis per document and flush to SQL Server on a debounce window plus a max-buffer threshold, with flush-on-last-user-leave and flush-on-shutdown.
acceptanceCriteria: Sustained typing by 5 users produces batched writes, not one write per keystroke
No update is lost across a graceful shutdown
Debounce interval and max batch size are configurable

tasks.title: Snapshot creation and compaction job
tasks.description: Periodic job that merges accumulated updates into a new snapshot when the delta count or byte size crosses a threshold, then prunes compacted change rows beyond a retention window.
acceptanceCriteria: Document reconstructed from a new snapshot is byte-identical in content to the pre-compaction state
Change rows older than the retention window and covered by a snapshot are removed
Compaction never runs concurrently for the same document

tasks.title: Document state integrity tests
tasks.description: Tests covering append/load round trips, compaction correctness, and buffer flush behaviour under simulated churn.
acceptanceCriteria: Replaying 1000 buffered updates yields the same state as an equivalent snapshot
Shutdown mid-buffer loses nothing

tasks.title: SignalR setup with JWT authentication
tasks.description: Register SignalR, map /hubs/document, and support token delivery via access_token query string for the WebSocket handshake while keeping the standard header path for other transports.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated connections are rejected at negotiate
Context.User carries the same claims as REST requests
MessagePack or JSON protocol choice is documented and configured

tasks.title: DocumentHub JoinDocument / LeaveDocument
tasks.description: Group-per-document join with access authorization, initial state handshake, connection registration, and clean leave/disconnect handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Joining without access throws a hub exception mapped to DOCUMENT_ACCESS_DENIED
Abrupt disconnect removes the connection from groups and presence within the configured timeout
Join returns the caller's effective role so the client can render read-only UI

tasks.title: SendDocumentUpdate and DocumentChanged relay
tasks.description: Accept binary Yjs updates from editors, validate edit permission, enqueue for persistence, and broadcast to all other group members with a monotonic sequence number.
acceptanceCriteria: Sender does not receive its own echo
Viewers and Commenters attempting to send updates are rejected and logged
Oversized payloads are rejected with a clear error code

tasks.title: Awareness, cursor and selection relay
tasks.description: Hub methods SendAwarenessUpdate, SendCursorUpdate and SendSelectionUpdate broadcasting AwarenessChanged / CursorChanged / SelectionChanged; ephemeral only, never persisted to SQL Server.
acceptanceCriteria: Awareness payloads never reach SQL Server
Updates are throttled server-side to protect against cursor spam
Viewers may broadcast presence but not content updates

tasks.title: Connection and session tracking
tasks.description: Track connectionId -> (userId, documentId) with support for multiple tabs per user, backed by an abstraction that starts in-memory and swaps to Redis in P5.
acceptanceCriteria: A user with two tabs appears once in presence but has two tracked connections
Registry entries are removed on disconnect and by a stale-entry sweep

tasks.title: Presence service and UserJoined / UserLeft / PresenceChanged events
tasks.description: Maintain per-document presence records (userId, name, avatar, activity, lastActiveAt) and broadcast join/leave/activity changes; expose a hub method to fetch the current roster on join.
acceptanceCriteria: Joining client receives the full current roster in one call
Activity distinguishes Editing from Viewing based on role and recent updates
Presence is stored outside SQL Server per PRD section 14

tasks.title: Hub error handling, throttling and payload limits
tasks.description: Hub filter translating exceptions into the standard error contract, per-connection message rate limits, max message size, and keep-alive/timeout tuning.
acceptanceCriteria: Hub exceptions reach the client as { message, code } without leaking internals
A flooding connection is throttled rather than taking down the hub
Keep-alive and client timeout values are documented

tasks.title: Reconnection resync endpoint
tasks.description: Allow a reconnecting client to send its state vector and receive the missing diff, so offline edits merge without a full document reload.
acceptanceCriteria: A client offline for 10 minutes resyncs with a diff, not a full document
Client-queued offline updates applied after reconnect are broadcast to others
No update is lost when reconnect races with an active edit

tasks.title: Real-time collaboration integration tests
tasks.description: Multi-client hub tests using in-process SignalR clients covering join, concurrent updates, presence lifecycle and reconnect resync.
acceptanceCriteria: Two clients editing concurrently converge to the same state
Disconnect removes the user from presence for the remaining client
Tests run deterministically in CI without sleeps

tasks.title: Redis connection and abstraction layer
tasks.description: Register a shared multiplexer with resilient connect options and expose typed helpers for hashes, sets and pub/sub used by presence and locks.
acceptanceCriteria: API starts in a degraded but functional mode when Redis is briefly unavailable
Connection is reused, not created per request

tasks.title: SignalR Redis backplane
tasks.description: Add the Redis backplane so hub broadcasts fan out across multiple API instances, with a channel prefix per environment.
acceptanceCriteria: Two API instances behind a proxy relay updates between clients connected to different instances
Environments do not cross-talk on shared Redis

tasks.title: Redis-backed presence and connection registry
tasks.description: Swap the in-memory registry and presence store for Redis hashes with TTL heartbeats and a sweeper for orphaned entries after instance crashes.
acceptanceCriteria: Killing an API instance clears its presence entries within the TTL window
Presence roster is consistent across instances

tasks.title: Distributed locks
tasks.description: Redis-based distributed lock primitive with owner token, TTL and safe release, used by snapshot compaction, version creation and document hard locks.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the lock owner can release it
Locks auto-expire so a crashed holder cannot deadlock a document
Compaction and version creation acquire the lock before writing

tasks.title: Document members endpoints
tasks.description: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE for /api/documents/{id}/members with Owner-only mutation, self-removal support and last-owner protection.
acceptanceCriteria: The last remaining Owner cannot be demoted or removed
Adding an existing member updates the role instead of duplicating
Non-owners get 403 on mutations

tasks.title: DocumentInvitations entity and migration
tasks.description: Create the DocumentInvitations table with Id, DocumentId, InvitedBy, Email, Role, TokenHash, ExpiresAt, AcceptedAt, CreatedAt and appropriate indexes.
acceptanceCriteria: TokenHash has a unique index
Composite index on (DocumentId, Email) supports duplicate-invite checks

tasks.title: Secure invitation token generation and validation
tasks.description: Generate cryptographically random tokens, store only their hash, validate with constant-time comparison, and enforce expiry plus single-use semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Raw token is returned exactly once, at creation
Accepted or expired tokens fail validation
Token entropy is at least 256 bits

tasks.title: POST /api/documents/{id}/invitations
tasks.description: Owner invites by email: if the user exists create the DocumentMember and notify directly; otherwise create an invitation with a token link.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing-user path creates membership immediately and returns member data
New-user path returns an invitation link containing the raw token
Re-inviting an existing pending email replaces the previous invitation

tasks.title: Accept and reject invitation endpoints
tasks.description: POST /api/invitations/{token}/accept creates the DocumentMember for the authenticated user and marks the invitation accepted; /reject marks it declined. Add a public preview endpoint returning document title and inviter for the landing page.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepting requires authentication and matches the invited email
A token cannot be accepted twice
Preview leaks no content, only title and inviter display name

tasks.title: Share links
tasks.description: Owner-managed share links granting Viewer or Editor access via a secure random token, with enable/disable, optional expiry, and resolution inside the access service. Document ids are never used as access tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: Disabling a link immediately revokes access for future requests and hub joins
Link tokens are stored hashed
Link-granted role never exceeds the configured role

tasks.title: End-to-end permission enforcement matrix
tasks.description: Audit every REST endpoint and hub method against the Owner/Editor/Commenter/Viewer matrix and close gaps; produce a machine-readable matrix used by tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Every endpoint and hub method has an explicit required permission - no implicit allow
Commenter cannot send document updates over the hub
Matrix is asserted by an automated test that fails on unmapped endpoints

tasks.title: Live permission-change propagation
tasks.description: When a member's role changes or is revoked, invalidate caches and push a PermissionChanged event to that user's connections, downgrading or disconnecting them mid-session.
acceptanceCriteria: Demoting an Editor to Viewer while connected stops their updates from being accepted within seconds
Removed members are ejected from the hub group
Covers PRD section 45 Test 8

tasks.title: Sharing, invitation and permission tests
tasks.description: Integration tests for member management, both invitation flows, share links, and mid-session permission revocation.
acceptanceCriteria: Token reuse, expiry and wrong-email acceptance are all covered
Permission matrix test fails when a new endpoint is added without a mapping

tasks.title: Comment entities and migration
tasks.description: Create Comments (Id, DocumentId, AuthorId, AnchorId, QuotedText, Body, Status, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt, ResolvedBy, ResolvedAt), CommentReplies and CommentMentions with configurations and migration.
acceptanceCriteria: AnchorId links a comment to a Yjs relative position stored by the client
Status supports Open and Resolved
Cascade delete removes replies and mentions with the parent comment

tasks.title: Comment CRUD endpoints
tasks.description: GET /api/documents/{id}/comments (with status filter), POST create, PUT /api/comments/{id}, DELETE /api/comments/{id} with author-or-owner authorization.
acceptanceCriteria: Commenter role can create comments but not edit the document
Only the author or the document owner can edit or delete a comment
Viewer can read comments but not create them

tasks.title: Comment replies
tasks.description: Threaded replies under a comment with create, edit and delete, returned nested in the comment list payload.
acceptanceCriteria: Replies are ordered by creation time
Deleting a parent comment deletes its replies
Reply authorization mirrors comment authorization

tasks.title: Resolve and reopen comments
tasks.description: POST /api/comments/{id}/resolve and /reopen recording who resolved and when, with resolved threads excluded from the default list.
acceptanceCriteria: Resolved comments are returned only when explicitly requested
Resolver identity and timestamp are persisted

tasks.title: Mentions parsing and mention records
tasks.description: Parse @mentions from comment bodies, resolve them to document members only, persist CommentMention rows and raise notification events. Add a mention-candidate search endpoint scoped to document members.
acceptanceCriteria: Mentions of non-members are ignored and never notified
Editing a comment reconciles added and removed mentions
Each mentioned user receives exactly one notification per comment version

tasks.title: Real-time comment events over the hub
tasks.description: Broadcast CommentAdded, CommentUpdated, CommentDeleted, CommentResolved to the document group so open editors update without polling.
acceptanceCriteria: A comment created by user A appears for user B without a refresh
Events are only sent to users with view access to the document

tasks.title: Comment tests
tasks.description: Integration tests for comment CRUD, replies, resolve flow, mention resolution and role-based authorization.
acceptanceCriteria: Viewer create attempt returns 403
Mention of a non-member creates no mention row

tasks.title: DocumentVersions entity and migration
tasks.description: Create DocumentVersions (VersionId, DocumentId, VersionNumber, CreatedBy, CreatedAt, ChangeType, SnapshotId, Label) with a ChangeType enum covering Created, ContentUpdate, AiRewrite, Restore.
acceptanceCriteria: VersionNumber is unique per document and gap-free
Every version references a snapshot that can reconstruct its content

tasks.title: Version creation service
tasks.description: Create versions at meaningful points - document creation, idle-after-substantial-change, accepted AI rewrite, explicit user save, and restore - using the distributed lock to avoid duplicate numbering.
acceptanceCriteria: Continuous typing does not create a version per keystroke
Concurrent triggers under load never produce duplicate version numbers
AI-accepted content produces a version with ChangeType AiRewrite

tasks.title: Version list and detail endpoints
tasks.description: GET /api/documents/{id}/versions grouped for the revision-history UI, and GET /versions/{versionId} returning reconstructed content for preview.
acceptanceCriteria: List includes author display name, timestamp, change type and label
Detail returns content that renders read-only on the client
Access requires at least Viewer role

tasks.title: Restore version endpoint with live broadcast
tasks.description: POST /api/documents/{id}/versions/{versionId}/restore applies the historical state as a new CRDT update (never a destructive overwrite), records a Restore version and broadcasts DocumentRestored to connected clients.
acceptanceCriteria: Restoring while other users are connected converges everyone to the restored content
Restore is itself undoable because it is applied as a normal update
Only Owner or Editor may restore
Covers PRD section 45 Test 9

tasks.title: Version comparison / diff endpoint
tasks.description: Compute a structural diff between two versions and return added/removed/changed blocks for the compare UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Diff is stable and deterministic for the same version pair
Response is bounded for very large documents

tasks.title: Versioning tests
tasks.description: Tests for version trigger rules, numbering under concurrency, restore correctness and restore-with-connected-clients.
acceptanceCriteria: Parallel version creation produces sequential numbers with no duplicates
Restore round trip reproduces the exact historical content

tasks.title: Document lock model
tasks.description: Represent locks with LockedBy, LockedAt, ExpiresAt and LockType (Soft, Hard) - hard locks persisted in SQL Server and mirrored in Redis, soft locks ephemeral in Redis only.
acceptanceCriteria: Soft locks never write to SQL Server
Hard locks survive an API restart until expiry

tasks.title: Lock acquire and release endpoints
tasks.description: POST /api/documents/{id}/lock and /unlock with Owner-only hard locking, renewal support and enforcement inside the hub update path.
acceptanceCriteria: While hard-locked, updates from anyone other than the lock holder are rejected with DOCUMENT_LOCKED
Only the holder or the owner can release a lock
Covers PRD section 45 Test 7

tasks.title: Lock expiry background job and hub events
tasks.description: Expire stale locks automatically and broadcast DocumentLocked / DocumentUnlocked to the document group on every lock transition.
acceptanceCriteria: A holder that disconnects has their lock released within the TTL
All connected clients see lock state change without a refresh

tasks.title: AIRequests entity and migration
tasks.description: Create AIRequests (Id, DocumentId, UserId, Operation, Model, PromptTokens, CompletionTokens, DurationMs, Status, ErrorCode, CreatedAt) for auditing and quota - storing metadata, not full document content.
acceptanceCriteria: No raw document text is persisted in the request log by default
Indexed by (UserId, CreatedAt) for quota queries

tasks.title: Ollama HTTP client with resilience
tasks.description: Typed HttpClient for Ollama generate/chat with configurable base URL and model, timeouts, cancellation, retry with backoff and a circuit breaker.
acceptanceCriteria: Ollama being down returns 503 with code AI_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE rather than hanging
Client request cancellation propagates and aborts the model call
Model name is configurable without a code change

tasks.title: Prompt template catalogue
tasks.description: Versioned prompt templates per operation (generate, rewrite, improve, summarize, expand, shorten, fix-grammar, change-tone, continue) with input length guards and instruction-injection mitigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Each operation has a dedicated template with explicit output constraints
Oversized selections are truncated with a clear rule, not silently
User text is delimited so it cannot override system instructions

tasks.title: AI service abstraction
tasks.description: IAiService exposing one method per operation, handling prompt building, model invocation, response post-processing and AIRequest logging. The AI layer never writes document content to SQL Server directly.
acceptanceCriteria: AI output is returned to the caller only - no document mutation server-side
Every invocation writes an AIRequest row with duration and status
Post-processing strips model preamble/markdown fences when not requested

tasks.title: AI authorization, rate limiting and quota
tasks.description: Require Editor or Owner role on the target document for all AI operations, apply a dedicated rate-limit bucket and a per-user daily quota with clear error codes.
acceptanceCriteria: Viewer and Commenter receive 403 on every AI endpoint
Quota exhaustion returns 429 with code AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
A document id is required and validated on every AI request

tasks.title: AI Phase 1 endpoints
tasks.description: Implement POST /api/ai/generate, /rewrite, /improve, /summarize, /expand, /shorten, /fix-grammar, /change-tone, /continue with a shared request shape (documentId, selection, context, options).
acceptanceCriteria: All nine operations return usable output for a representative sample input
Responses include the operation, model and elapsed time
Errors follow the standard envelope

tasks.title: Streaming AI responses
tasks.description: Stream tokens to the client over Server-Sent Events or IAsyncEnumerable so long generations render progressively, with cancellation support.
acceptanceCriteria: First token reaches the client well before completion
Client abort cancels the Ollama call and closes the stream
A partial stream still records an AIRequest row with status Cancelled

tasks.title: AI Phase 2 document-aware endpoints
tasks.description: Ask-about-document, whole-document summarization, outline generation, action items and meeting notes, built on the current document snapshot with context-window-aware truncation.
acceptanceCriteria: Document content is loaded from the snapshot, not from the client payload
Documents exceeding the context window degrade gracefully with a documented strategy

tasks.title: AI service tests with mocked Ollama
tasks.description: Unit tests for prompt construction and post-processing, and integration tests for all AI endpoints with a stubbed Ollama server covering success, timeout and failure paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests never call a real model
Timeout and circuit-open behaviour is asserted
Authorization tests cover all four roles

tasks.title: Document chunking service
tasks.description: Split document content into overlapping semantic chunks with stable ids so re-indexing only touches changed chunks.
acceptanceCriteria: Chunk boundaries respect block structure where possible
Unchanged content produces identical chunk ids across runs

tasks.title: Embeddings generation via Ollama
tasks.description: Batch embedding generation with a configurable embedding model, retry handling and dimension validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Embedding dimension mismatch fails loudly at startup or first call
Batching keeps throughput acceptable for a large document

tasks.title: Qdrant client and collection management
tasks.description: Create and migrate the vector collection, upsert and delete points with documentId payload filtering for tenant isolation.
acceptanceCriteria: Searches are always filtered by documentId
Collection is created idempotently on startup

tasks.title: Background indexing pipeline
tasks.description: BackgroundService that re-indexes a document after a debounce following content changes, removing stale chunks and upserting new ones.
acceptanceCriteria: Editing does not trigger an embedding call per keystroke
Deleted documents have their vectors purged

tasks.title: RAG question-answering endpoint
tasks.description: POST /api/ai/ask retrieving top-k relevant chunks for the document, composing a grounded prompt and returning the answer with source chunk references.
acceptanceCriteria: Answers cite the chunks they were derived from
A question with no relevant context returns an explicit 'not found in document' response
Access control matches other AI endpoints

tasks.title: Notifications entity and endpoints
tasks.description: Notifications table (Id, UserId, Type, Title, Body, DocumentId, RefId, IsRead, CreatedAt) with list, mark-read and mark-all-read endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Users only ever see their own notifications
Unread count is available in a single cheap query

tasks.title: Notification service and real-time delivery
tasks.description: INotificationService raising notifications for mentions, invitations, membership changes and document shares, delivered live to the recipient's connections via a user-scoped hub channel.
acceptanceCriteria: A mentioned user connected elsewhere receives the notification without a refresh
Offline recipients see the notification on next login
Notification creation never blocks the originating request

tasks.title: Audit logging service and interceptor
tasks.description: AuditLogs entity plus a service that records the PRD section 43 event list (login, document opened, joined/left, changed, version created, permission changed, invitation created, AI request, restored, lock acquired/released) asynchronously.
acceptanceCriteria: Every event in PRD section 43 has a corresponding audit write
Audit writes never block or fail the primary operation
No passwords, tokens or full document content are stored

tasks.title: Audit query and administration endpoints
tasks.description: Filtered audit queries for document owners (their documents) and admins (global), plus basic admin endpoints for user listing and deactivation.
acceptanceCriteria: Document owners can only query audit rows for their documents
Admin endpoints require an explicit admin policy, not just authentication

tasks.title: Critical collaboration scenario test suite
tasks.description: Automate all nine PRD section 45 scenarios end to end: same-paragraph concurrency, five-user distributed edits, offline divergence, mid-edit disconnect, reconnect with pending changes, AI-during-edit, lock-during-edit, permission loss while connected, and restore while connected.
acceptanceCriteria: All nine scenarios pass repeatably in CI
Each scenario asserts final-state convergence across every participating client
No test relies on fixed sleeps for synchronization

tasks.title: Load testing harness
tasks.description: Scripted load test driving N simulated SignalR clients per document with realistic typing patterns, measuring end-to-end update latency percentiles and server resource use.
acceptanceCriteria: 50 concurrent editors on one document stay under 200ms p95 perceived latency
No dropped CRDT updates across the run
Results are reproducible and recorded

tasks.title: Horizontal scaling validation
tasks.description: Run multiple API instances behind a reverse proxy with sticky-session-free WebSockets and validate the Redis backplane under load, including instance failure mid-session.
acceptanceCriteria: Clients on different instances collaborate with no visible difference
Killing one instance reconnects its clients elsewhere with no lost updates
100+ concurrent users per document is demonstrated or the gap is documented

tasks.title: Metrics and monitoring
tasks.description: Expose application metrics (active connections, updates/sec, persistence lag, AI latency, hub errors) via OpenTelemetry/Prometheus with a starter dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Persistence buffer lag is observable in real time
Hub error rate and AI failure rate have dedicated metrics

tasks.title: Security hardening review
tasks.description: Systematic pass over the PRD section 41 checklist: authorization coverage, token handling, invitation token security, rate limits, CORS, input validation, hub authorization, AI endpoint authorization and dependency vulnerability scan.
acceptanceCriteria: Every item in PRD section 41 is marked verified with evidence
No known high-severity dependency vulnerabilities remain
Any accepted risk is explicitly documented

tasks.title: Backend Dockerfile, compose and CI pipeline
tasks.description: Multi-stage Dockerfile for the API, full docker-compose.yml including frontend/backend/sqlserver/redis/ollama/qdrant, and a CI workflow running build, tests and image publish.
acceptanceCriteria: docker compose up brings the whole stack to a working state from a clean machine
Migrations are applied automatically or via a documented one-liner
CI fails the build when any test fails
